card.name: Positions right before the word exchange
card.fires_on: The word or comma just before an expected "exchange", mainly in overdose text: "respiratory" in "adequate respiratory exchange" and the comma after "methylene blue" before "exchange transfusion".

modes.label: Respiratory exchange

modes.example: Attention should be given to the reestablishment of adequate<< respiratory>> exchange through provision of a patent airway

modes.label: Comma before exchange transfusion
modes.description: A comma after "methylene blue" in a list of treatments, just before "exchange transfusion".
modes.example: A more severe clinical presentation may require treatment with methylene blue<<,>> exchange transfusion, or hyperbaric

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word "exchange" next and suppresses unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It fires when the next word is likely to be "exchange", as in respiratory exchange or exchange transfusion.
